selectionPolicy: Editorially selected illustrative pairs: stable labels in both passes, explicit explanations relevant to the current goal, distinct size ranges, and comparable sizes within each positive/negative pair. Peptides are matched exactly by length; molecules are approximately matched by molecular weight. These are not random samples, causal controls, or validated activity rankings. No selection uses downstream activity or docking scores.

g0.label: 38 amino acids
g0.selectionReason: A longer pair with an explicit charge-based distinction and stated folding uncertainties.
